title: lobelia paucidentata
intro: Lobelia paucidentata, commonly known as Lobelia, is a plant species native to the Americas. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is also valued for its ornamental value. The health benefits of Lobelia paucidentata include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and its use as a diuretic to alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia paucidentata include alkaloids like lobeline and lobelanine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including stimulating the respiratory system and acting as a bronchodilator.
